sections: Fergana Media is an electronic mass media outlet that brings together regional journalism, analysis, and multimedia content in one platform.
Our goal is to give readers reliable, fast, and clear news, analysis, and special projects that show the full context of events.
The site operates as a registered e-media outlet; the editorial team follows professional journalism standards in an independent environment.
Use the link below to meet our team, projects, and official materials.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
sections: This privacy policy explains how your personal data may be collected, stored, and protected when you use the Fergana Media website and services.
Information you provide through the site (for example, comments or profile data) may be used to deliver services, moderate content, and comply with legal requirements.
We do not sell your data; it may be shared only when required by law or security needs, or with your explicit consent.
Cookies and technical data may be used to improve the site and gather statistics; you can limit them in your browser settings.
For questions, use the contacts on the “Contact” page. This policy may be updated from time to time.

termsPage.title: Terms of service
sections: Using Fergana Media means you accept these terms. Content is protected by copyright and publication rules.
Users must provide accurate information, treat others respectfully, and must not post unlawful material.
The editorial team may moderate comments, remove violating content, or restrict accounts.
We are not responsible for third-party sites linked from our pages or their privacy practices.
Terms may change; continued use means you accept the updates. Disputes are governed by the laws of Uzbekistan.
